name: Personal Trades Terminal — Indian Equity Analysis Platform
description: Personal TechnoFunda equity research and trading terminal for Indian markets, covering an NSE universe of over 1,000 stocks across the NIFTY 500, F&O, Midcap and Smallcap segments. Stocks are ranked on a 100-point Call / Score on TechnoFunda basis, a 16-signal Indicators Matrix Summary and the Mark Minervini SEPA Trend Template with VCP detection, combined into one filterable list of Top TechnoFunda Buy Watchlists. It has screeners covering 52-week and all-time-high breakouts, Donchian channel breakouts and HVE / HVY / HVQ institutional volume surges, which are essential in identifying good trade setups. It also has a 4-pillar NSE Sector Scorecard that rates each sector from 0 to 100 on trend, relative strength versus the NIFTY 500, momentum and breadth, with RRG rotation quadrants to identify right sectors for trades. The terminal also includes interactive volume-candle charts with Donchian and Supertrend signals, Trade Radar & Regime, Fundamental Lab, Closing Bell Lab, AI TechnoFunda Briefs and risk reviews, and Indian STCG/LTCG tax-aware portfolio risk and rebalancing analytics. All data is refreshed through automated NSE Bhavcopy end-of-day ingestion.
